title: Sunday · the corn
logline: The Sunday before the tenth anniversary: the drafting table from above with a tray of corn on it and the first strip pinned to the wall above, drawn in the Sunday's watercolor. An object as a landscape, three years before the invitation gets the same treatment.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the drafting table from above: a paper tray of buttered corn, a mug, a brush, and at the top edge the wall with a yellowed strip pinned to it.

panels.composition: Tier 2: the corn, close, in watercolor: the butter pooling, the kernels, the salt.
